newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA GASOLINE PRICES FALL NEXT WEEK.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA GASOLINE PRICES FALL NEXT WEEK.

text.p: South Africa's Central Energy Fund said gasoline prices would fall by five cents per litre in the interior of the country and six cents on the coast with effect from June 4.
The diesel price goes up by one cent in the interior but is unchanged on the coast.
Interior illuminating paraffin falls by 2.8 cents in the interior and four cents on the coast.
The Central Energy Fund said most prices were coming down in line with international trends, but an increase in the Petronet pipeline rates slightly offset this for inland rates.
From June 4 the price of 93 octane gasoline in the Gauteng area around Johannesburg will be 217 cents. At the coast the price goes to 206.
The price of diesel in Gauteng will be 207 cents and 196 cents on the coast, while illuminating paraffin goes to 120.73 cents in Gauteng and 107.43 at the coast.
